# Example of the voice

An invented story, for tone only. Never copy its lines.

> A lighthouse keeper finds his own name carved into a coffin. On an island where nobody has
> died in forty years. His name is Elias, and he has six weeks left on his contract. So he
> counts down the days and ignores the coffin. But the supply boat stops coming. Then the
> radio dies. Which means the only voice left on the island is his own... until the night
> someone knocks from inside the lighthouse.
